title: TAI exact activation dispatch authority
objective: Allow restricted Qwen activation to consume only an explicitly dispatched, exact-main, successful TAI Automatic REG.RU Preflight workflow_run while preserving the deterministic owner issue-command fallback and all protected activation, acceptance, rollback and deployment gates.
boundaries: Activation remains workflow_dispatch-only and never listens directly to issue_comment or workflow_run
The dispatch actor and triggering actor must be the repository owner or github-actions[bot]
Activation requires the exact successful TAI Automatic REG.RU Preflight run ID and run attempt supplied by the automatic preflight publisher
Activation waits at most 300 seconds for that exact upstream run to reach a terminal state, then requires completed success
The upstream preflight run must be event workflow_run, branch main, exact current-main SHA and have an owner-or-github-actions actor pair
All six automatic preflight jobs must be completed successfully
The manual /tai activate current-main owner command remains separately available and unchanged
All exact image, protected REG.RU controller, RU/EN/ZH SSE, potato, Chromium, rollback, finalization and automatic deployment gates remain unchanged
No direct production SSH, Docker authority, tenant, role, model admission, financial or write authority is widened
